shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Full cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), and a subsystem-health panel. LIVE on Workshop 3776015553. §73 transit clips (stairs B / ladder C / elevator B) IMPLEMENTED, build green, FIELD-UNTESTED - §297 regression test is the gate. Also owed: Workshop smoke test, §62.N/§70 verifies, upstream paste.

# As above, So below II (V2)

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans are COMPAT ONLY. (2) Building-sprite art comes from the USER via Nano Banana Pro prompt kits (user lore, assets topic); agent-generated SVG building art was rejected as "cheap art". render_svg_to_png is for flat UI geometry only. (3) About.xml description is the USER's copy - never rewrite during publish prep, only on explicit request. (4) **§73 lesson: when the user asks for N mockups of a feature, they want N CHOICES to pick between, not N instances of one design - present OPTIONS.**

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE THIRTY-SEVEN RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION (§29e/§46/§53/§56.4). 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` (§29c). 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS (§56.3). 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD ON WHAT IS ON THE MAP. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): **`TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME.** 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY GATE THAT ASKS "IS THIS MAP READY YET". 21 (§58): **THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT.** 22 (§59): **A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT.** 23 (§60): **AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL.** 24 (§61a): **CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR.** 25 (§61b): **A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED.** 26 (§61f): **EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE SAME "IS IT DRAWN" GATE THE RENDERER USES.** 27 (§62c): **PREFER THE OPERATION EVERY HOST IS ALREADY FORCED TO HANDLE (SPAWN/DESPAWN) OVER THE ONE EACH HOST HANDLES ITS OWN WAY (FLICK).** 28 (§63a): **A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE.** 29 (§0b): **REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS.** 30 (§66d): **A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER.** 31 (§66f): **WHEN A GUARDED HANDOFF FAILS IN THE FIELD, MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED.** 32 (§69a): **TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT.** 33 (§62k): **A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO.** 34 (§62l): **AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER, NOT JUST THE MAP MESH; the map mesh and each overlay are SEPARATE METHODS.** 35 (§62n): **MAKING A CLONED FOREIGN DEF VISIBLE ENTERS IT INTO EVERY FOREIGN LOOKUP THE HOST BUILT FROM ITS OWN AUTHORED LISTS - AND IT IS IN NONE OF THEM.** 36 (§70a): **WHEN WE SPAWN SOMETHING VANILLA NORMALLY SPAWNS, WE MUST RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE, NOT A SUMMARY OF IT.** 37 (§71a): **NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. Read the engine's own handler for the transition you are predicting.**

# 73. TRANSIT ANIMATIONS — IMPLEMENTED (build green 0w/0e), FIELD-UNTESTED (ledger 22)

**Picks (user-locked):** STAIRS B "Tread steps" (grand stairs share it), LADDER C "Peek and drop", ELEVATOR B "Freight lift". Timings = mockup defaults. Elevator = pawn-only v1 (no car sprite; offer a Nano Banana car-plate kit later). Mechanism approved incl. the ghost-window caveat. Mockups remain in `mockups/` for reference (never ship; strip move 5).

**Architecture (all in `Source/V2/ABStairAnim.cs`, class name kept so call sites survive):**
- **Carry untouched.** `ABWormholePather` both teleport sites call `ABStairAnim.NotifyTransited(pawn, t.near, t.far, prePos, landing)` AFTER Position/Notify_Teleported - a pure observer, exactly like the old pop-out. `prePos` captured before the Position write; it derives `glideDir` (approach direction into the mouth; falls back to the anchor's Rotation.FacingCell).
- **Post-hop hold:** `p.stances.stagger.StaggerFor(entry+hold, 0f)` (elevator: board+travel). ⚠ Stagger is stat-scaled (`StaggerDurationFactor`) and awoken corpses refuse it, so the Sweep cuts to emerge the moment the pawn LEAVES ITS LANDING CELL - clips key off actual state, never off the nominal hold. A stagger-immune pawn just gets a shorter show.
- **Ghost pass** (`DrawGhosts`, called from the `DynamicDrawManager.DrawDynamicThings` postfix after `DrawBelowPawns`): for each clip in its ghost window whose ORIGIN band is on camera, runs the pawn's THREE DynamicDrawPhases at the origin mouth (the ABBelowDynamicDraw staleness lesson: never just DrawNowAt), with `ghostArmedId` armed in a finally and `ABBelowRenderCache.BeginPawn/EndPawn` bracketing (IsAnimating vetoes the atlas blit, so the pose matrix is honored). NOT a matrix translation: bands are map regions, the camera clamp culls the pawn's normal draw whenever the player watches the origin band, so there is no draw call to translate - the ghost IS the draw call.
- **Hide at landing:** while ghosting, the pawn's normal draw (camera on destination band) collapses to a 0.002 dot via the pose's `hide` flag - scale IS the hide mechanism (no alpha path). See-below pass skips ghosting pawns (`IsGhosting` gate in the DrawBelowPawns loop) so it cannot draw a second copy through the stair opening. Pawn name label suppressed while ghosting (`Patch_PawnUIOverlay_ABGhostLabel` prefix).
- **Pose plumbing:** `TryGetPose(pawn, out ClipPose{offX,offZ,rot,sx,sz,hide})` consumed by the ONE `GetDrawParms` postfix (`ABBelowShrink`), right-multiplied as `TRS(offset, Euler(0,rot,0), (sx*s,1,sz*s))` composing with the depth-cue scale s. `ScaleFor`/`ShimmyFor` are gone; `IsAnimating` kept for both cache-veto sites. Threading discipline preserved: count-guard fast path, dictionary written only on the game tick, worker-thread reads pure.
- **Clip content:** STAIRS entry 26t = 5 stepped treads along `glideDir` (dwell-pull-dwell easing), hop + alternating ±5° lean, scale 1→0.32 down / 1→1.14 up, `Vanish` final shrink (scale-only stand-in for a fade: "swallowed by the opening"); hold 6t (nobody drawn - the mockup's gap); emerge 26t = 4 treads out, sliding from the FAR ANCHOR cell to the landing cell (covers stepped-aside landings), from-above settles 1.14→1 behind a fast `reveal` pop-in ramp, from-below grows 0.32→1 with a settle bump. LADDER entry 40t = peek beat (lean 14° down / -10° up, first 15%) then TWO big pulls (±0.09 rock, ±7° lean), hold 8t, emerge 30t = head-pop from 0.18 with overshoot bounce then two pulls out (from below) / two drops + hop off the last rung (from above). ELEVATOR entry = board 8t (weight-dip late in the board + clank `ThrowDustPuff` at the origin, thrown at notify) + sink half of travel (10t/level, shake = sin(70/s)*0.03 jitter), emerge = rise half + landing bounce (sx 1.10/sz 0.88 squash + dip) with the landing puff thrown from the Sweep at q=0.86.
- **Counters (rule 15):** PopsStarted / GhostsDrawn / AnimFramesApplied / CacheVetoes / live count in `CountersLine()` (transit-health report caller unchanged).
- **Settings:** `transitAnim` (default ON) in the visuals section; OFF = old instant hop, no clip, no stagger. Keyed AB_TransitAnim/AB_TransitAnimTip.
- **Deleted:** `ReadyToCarry` (the run #297 gate) - no callers; its lesson lives in the new banner and the pather comment now points at the inverted-delay design.

**⚠ KNOWN HONEST MISMATCH (user-accepted, rule 26 exception, ledger 16):** during the ghost window the pawn is LOGICALLY at the destination (hittable, turret-targetable) while its sprite is at the origin mouth. Priced fallback if the field hates it: skip ghost+hold for hostiles (one faction check in NotifyTransited). Selection brackets during ghost still draw at the landing (only the LABEL is hidden) - tolerated v1.

**⚠ FIELD VERIFY LIST (in order):** (1) **§297 REGRESSION - THE GATE:** order pawns across stairs/ladder/elevator both directions, orders COMPLETE, no re-segmentation loops, no stuck-at-stairwell; drafted and undrafted both. (2) Ghost visible: watching the ORIGIN band, the pawn descends/climbs at the mouth (stairs = discrete treads, ladder = peek then two pulls, elevator = clank + sinking shake). (3) Watching the DESTINATION band: nothing during ghost (no dot artifact at the landing - if a shadow or dot shows, the hide scale needs the shadow node checked), then the emerge clip. (4) Hold feel: ~0.5s stairs, ~0.8s ladder, ~0.3s+ per elevator level; multi-level elevator rides hold longer and the landing bounce+dust fires. (5) `AB2: transit health` counters line: started/ghost draws/anim frames/cache vetoes all advancing (rule 33: zero anywhere = a silently dead half). (6) Stagger side effects: no pawn stuck after clip end (watchdog margin 600t exists), no melee weirdness at the mouth. (7) Zoomed OUT (past ZoomRootSize 18): clips still visible (cache veto working). (8) Known-mismatch observations: how bad does turret-fire-at-invisible-pawn read; decide hostile-skip fallback.
